relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: These data demonstrate that imaging can be used to visualize and measure cold pain signaling in dorsal root ganglion neurons due to L-type voltage-gated calcium channel activity triggered by Nav 1.8 activation.

relationships.subject: A-803467
relationships.evidence_quote: A-803467 has been established as a potent and selective inhibitor of Nav 1.8.

relationships.subject: A-803467
relationships.evidence_quote: A-803467 significantly inhibited DRG neuron ∆F/F, with the vehicle control showing minimal inhibitory effect (Fig 5C-D).

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with the TRPV1 antagonist, capsazepine, significantly reduced the ∆F/F response to capsaicin (Fig 1B), confirming the ∆F/F response was mediated by TRPV1-induced calcium influx.

relationships.subject: nifedipine
relationships.evidence_quote: Pre-treatment of Nifedipine inhibited VTD-induced calcium influx in the ex vivo model (Fig 3C).

key_findings: Intravital GCaMP6f imaging showed cold paw swab raises DRG neuron calcium transients, which are blocked by the Nav1.8 inhibitor A-803467.
Nav1.8-triggered sodium influx drives calcium entry via L-type VGCCs; TRPV1 inhibition did not block veratridine-induced calcium influx.
